translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Esaúnu sera' jimula
Entsalaa Esaú tityumee, matyu Edom tiitinu rukunu sera' jimu chachilla deeve.
Esaú Canaánnu sera' jimu chachilla' na'malanaa supungamuwaami: Hetnu sera' jimu chachi Elón' na'ma Adánu bain, Hevenu sera' jimu chachi Sibón' paña Aná' na'ma Oholibamánu bain,
tsenmin Ismael' na'ma, matyu Nebaiot' tsujki Basematnu bain.
Elifazyaa, Adá Esaúnu ka' kuñu nami; tsenmala Basematyaa Reuelnu nakami.
Tsenmala Oholibamáya, Jeúsnu bain, Jaalamnu bain, Corénu bain nakami. Entsalaa Esaú' nala, Canaán tusha nakayamula deeve.

Esaú, naa ya' shinbulanu bain, naa ya' kaillanu bain, naa yaba chumulanu bain dekake' vee tenasha mijiimi, matyu ya' naatala Jacobnu vela' jitu. Tsejtu kumuinchi Canaánnu chu' demiyandiñu animaala bain, naa tiba detadiñu jumula bain detajiimi,
matyu yala pai naatala jumula pure' animaa tandiya deitu bulu chunu jutyui detiyatu, tsenmin kumuinchi animaalanu tape fikaanu dekenmala yala' chunu tu bain tse'kityuñu' mitya.
Tsenñaa Esaú tityumee Edom tiitinu unbere Seír kuyi tenasha ji' chumi.
Entsalaa Esaúnu, tsandityumee, Edomnu sera' jimu chachilla deeve, matyu Seír kuyi tenasha chumula.
Entsalaa Esaú' nala' mumu deeve: Adába keñu na Elifaz bain, naa Basematba keñu na Reuel bain.
Tsenmala entsalaa Elifaz' na jumuwaala: Temán bain, Omar bain, Sefó bain, Gatam bain, naa Quenaz bain.
Tsenmin Elifazchi kama miyandinu shinbu Timnába vera na mamiyandimuwaami; tsenñu entsaa Amalecnu nakami. Tsa' mitya entsalaa Esaú' shinbu Adánu sera' jimula deeve.
Tsenmala Reuel' nalaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Náhat bain, Zérah bain, Samá bain, naa Mizá bain. Tsa' mitya entsalaa Esaú' shinbu Basematnu sera' jimula deeve.
Tsenmala Esaú' shinbu Oholibamá' naka' kuñuya entsalaa jumuwaala: Jeús bain, Jaalam bain, naa Coré bain. Entsa Oholibamá shinbu Aná' na'mawaami, matyu Sibón' paña.
Esaúnu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamulaya entsalaa jumuwaala: Esaúchi ajke' na Elifaznu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamulaya entsalaa juwaala: Temán bain, Omar bain, Sefó bain, Quenaz bain,
Coré bain, Gatam bain, naa Amalec bain. Tsa' mitya entsalaa Elifaznu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamula deeve, Edom tusha, tsenmin kumuinchi entsalaa Adánu sera' jimula deeve.

Tsenmala Esaú' na Reuelnu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamulaya entsalaa juntsala deeve: Náhat bain, Zérah bain, Samá bain, naa Mizá bain. Tsa' mitya entsalaa Reuelnu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamuwaala Edom tusha, tsenmin kumuinchi entsalaa Esaú' shinbu Basematnu sera' jimula deeve.
Tsenmala Aná' na'ma, Esaú' shinbu Oholibamánu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamulaya entsalaa juntsala deeve: Jeús bain, Jaalam bain, naa Coré bain.
Tsa' mitya kumuinchi entsalaa Esaú, tsandityumee Edomnu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamula deeve.
Hor chachi Seírnu sera' jimula
Tsenmala juntsa tusha chumula, Hor chachi Seírnu sera' jimulaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Lotán bain, Sobal bain, Sibón bain, Aná bain,
Disón bain, Éser bain, naa Disán bain; entsalaa Hor chachi Seírnu sera' jimu bale ruku tiyamula deeve Edom tusha.
Lotán' nalaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Horí bain, Hemam bain. Tsenmala Timnáya Lotán' tsujkiwaami.
Tsenmala Sobal' nalaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Alván bain, Manáhat bain, Ebal bain, Sefó bain, naa Onam bain.
Tsenmala Sibón' nalaya entsaa juntsa deeve: Aiá bain, Aná bain. Tsenmala entsa Anáya tiba den chutyu tenasha, ya' apa Sibónchi buru washkendu, tu tainsha pi faamu katamuwaami.
Tsenmala Anáya main unbeena Disónnu miyandi', main supu na'ma Oholibamánu miyandimuwaami.
Tsenmala Disón' nalaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Hemdán bain, Esbán bain, Itrán bain, naa Querán bain.
Tsenmala Éser' nalaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Bilhán bain, Zaaván bain, naa Acán bain.
Tsenmala Disán' nalaya entsalaa juntsa deeve: Us bain, Arán bain.
Hor chachinu sera' jimula' bale ruku tiyamula entsalaa juntsa deeve: Lotán bain, Sobal bain, Sibón bain, Aná bain,
Disón bain, Éser bain, naa Disán bain. Tsa' mitya entsalaa Hor chachinu sera' jimula' bale ruku tiyamuwaala, matyu ma bulu chachimeemee, Seír tusha.
Entsalaa Edom tusha rei tiyamuwaala Israel chachilla kayu rei tajtunu uwanu:
Beor' na, Bela, Edom tusha rei tiyamuwaami Dinhaba mumu pebulunu.
Tsejtu Bela peyañu, ya' mitya Zérah' na Jobabya rei mavimi, Bosrá pebulusha chumu.
Tsenmala Jobab peyanmala ya' mitya Husamya rei mavimi, Temán tusha chumu.
Tsenmala Husam peyanmalaya, ya' mitya Bedad' na Hadadya rei mavi' washkemi, Avit pebulusha chumu. Entsa Hadadya, Madiánnu, Moab jeenbaasha vingue' puimuwaami.
Tsenmala Hadad peyañu ya' mitya Samláya rei mavi' washkemi, Masrecá pebulusha chumu.
Tsenmala Samlá peyañu, ya' mitya Saúlya rei mandi' washkemi, matyu pi keesha chumu pebulu Rehobotnu chumu.
Saúl peyañu, ya' mitya Acbor' na, Baal-hanánya, rei mandi' washkemi.
Tsenmala Baal-hanán peyañu Hadadya rei mandi' washkemi, Pau pebulusha chumu. Hadad' shinbu Mehetabel mumuwaami, matyu Matred' na'ma, tsenmin Mezaab' paña.
Tsenmala entsalaa Esaúnu sera' jimu paande chachilla' mumu deeve, matyu main main ya' bulu chachimee, naa tenatala pañu bain, naa mumutala pañu bain: Timná bain, Alvá bain, Jetet bain,
Oholibamá bain, Elá bain, Pinón bain,
Quenaz bain, Temán bain, Mibsar bain,
Magdiel bain, naa Iram bain. Tsenmala Esaúren, naa Edom mumu bain juwaami. Tsa' mitya entsalaa Edom tusha balen chachi tiyamuwaala, matyu main main naaju tenanu chumuwa' bain.
